items.summary: Ensure Forge “Direct Injection” image uploads are processed into a new square PNG at the project’s configured output dimensions before being saved into project state (so the stored image matches what the app displays). Processing must: (1) resize to exactly project.settings.outputSize x project.settings.outputSize, and (2) apply pixel mode by disabling canvas image smoothing when project.pixelArtMode is enabled.

Discard the original, unprocessed uploaded file once processing is complete: do not persist original dimensions or original image bytes in project.customTokens or any other long-lived project state used for export/upload.

Verify the IPFS/Pinata upload pipeline uses the processed images for any NFTs originating from Forge uploads by ensuring the imageData that flows into uploadCollectionToIPFS (project.generatedNFTs[*].imageData) is the processed Forge output rather than the original upload data URL.
